experiment: E01 representation test on public human ECoG

dataset.description: Human ECoG, 256-channel grid, reading consonant-vowel syllables aloud (Chang Lab, UCSF)
dataset.channel_selection: all 4-channel HDF5 chunks whose electrodes are all labelled precentral/postcentral (anatomical, label-free): 60 of 79 sensorimotor electrodes
dataset.units_note: stored values: 99.99th pct |x| = 1.207e-03; NWB conversion attribute = 0.001 (to volts). Taken literally that is 1.207 uV (implausibly small for ECoG); interpreting stored values as volts gives 1207 uV (plausible). Ambiguous metadata: the analysis uses relative, label-free scaling so absolute units do not affect the comparison.

chip_config.event_threshold_rule: 5 x median over channels of the per-channel MAD in the 7 s rest epoch (single global threshold, as in hardware)
chip_config.model: numpy chip-equivalent of docs/V03_READOUT_SPEC.md (FEATURE) and hbci_event_core (EVENT); the TypeScript port of the same spec matches the RTL trace bit-exactly

analysis.host_features: log mean high-gamma (70-150 Hz FFT band-pass + Hilbert amplitude) and mean 0.5-20 Hz potential per 50 ms bin, from the int16 RAW samples
analysis.classifier: standardise -> PCA(20) -> LDA with fixed shrinkage 0.5, fit inside each fold
analysis.validation: stratified 5-fold x 20 repeats; label-permutation null with 200 shuffles

limitations: single subject, single session, 67 vowel trials: not evidence about people in general
offline analysis of a published recording; no HBCI-01 hardware recorded anything
the RAW representation is evaluated with one host feature recipe; better decoders could extract more
FEATURE uses one 2nd-order band-pass at 70-150 Hz; other bands or windows would give different numbers
EVENT uses one global threshold rule fixed in advance
units in the NWB file are ambiguous (see units_note)
